case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised friendly, welcoming staff, cleanliness, recent modernization, good value for money, easy access, and features like a balcony and proximity to Porto. Multiple reviews noted limited or poor breakfast variety, noise disturbances (traffic or noisy neighbors), bedding and mattress comfort issues, small rooms for some guests, and mixed parking experiences including parking located far from the entrance.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.area: Room comfort & urgent maintenance (mattresses, noise, mould, clogged drains, smoke infiltration)
priorities.recommendation: Immediately inspect rooms for mould/ventilation/drainage; evaluate mattresses, compile prioritized replacement/topper-plan; investigate smoke routes; remediate/escalate-if-hazards; record/respond-directly.

priorities.area: Breakfast quality, variety and service (food & beverage)
priorities.recommendation: Review breakfast offerings and service with F&B staff; evaluate variety, timing, implement adjustments, measure feedback.

priorities.area: Guest-facing descriptions and expectation alignment (marketing & communications)
priorities.recommendation: Review guest-facing descriptions for accurate distances, room, smoking, renovation details; establish brief check-in checklist.
Standardize slightly-expanded continental offering; train staff; review suppliers, test modest upgrades and portion-control; communicate improvements.

priorities.area: Noise and soundproofing (traffic and neighbouring guests)
priorities.recommendation: Offer earplugs, reassign road-facing guests, add quiet reminders, audit noise, cost soundproofing, update booking notes.
Provide mattress toppers, pillows, replace worn linens, assess, plan phased replacement by inventory and budget.
